data.name: Summer Rage
data.description: The barbarian channels the heat of late summer, making the air around her hot and oppressive. A creature within the barbarian's reach becomes fatigued as long as it remains within the barbarian's reach unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC %1) to become immune for 24 hours.|10+RagePowersLVL/+CON
